hypotheses.I1_feature_selectivity: For known categories, ablating top spectral modes changes the selected feature coordinate at least twice as much per unit input edit as norm-matched low-mode edits, at both ranks 1 and 4.
hypotheses.I2_downstream_specificity: For known categories, top-mode ablations produce at least 1.5 times the downstream Fisher effect energy of norm-matched low-mode edits at rank 4.
hypotheses.I3_feature_mediation: At rank 4, at least four of five known categories have median downstream mediation fidelity at least 0.30 under either the minimum-norm feature dual or SAE decoder intervention.
hypotheses.I4_decoder_advantage: Across known categories at rank 4, SAE-decoder mediation exceeds minimum-norm-dual mediation by at least 0.10 in median fidelity.
hypotheses.I5_prospective_gap: Rank-4 best-mediator fidelity is at least 0.10 higher for the five known categories than for the three prospective categories.
